widens `antigravity-cli.release`. Host `agy` was not on PATH.

Official artifacts stayed in `/tmp`. Extracted linux-x64 `--version`

`1.1.17` share commit `efa16f09…`; the GitHub assets are distinct

The frozen `1.1.15` corpus stays.
